block.title: Typed Rocq fixtures halve the linked images’ source size
block.p: The extracted module decoder reads the linked GNU Hello and HiAtexit terms. The printer writes their functions and data directly as Gallina constructors. Together the two images occupy 8,111,541 bytes of source, down from 18,070,744 bytes.

For the captured __GI__IO_wfile_overflow function alone, Rocq 9.3.0 compiled the raw term, its decoded module and its decoding witness in 1.08 seconds. It compiled the typed function and module in 0.47 seconds. These are medians from three local runs of each form on macOS. The compiled object shrank from 118,429 to 38,690 bytes.
